Almond Crusted Torte
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:46pm

Ingredients




1 2/3 cups plain flour
1 1/2 cups sugar
1 cup butter, melted
1/8 teaspoon salt
2 tablespoons almond extract
2 eggs, beaten
No-stick vegetable spray
2 1/4 ounces sliced almonds

Preparation

1 Stir together all ingredients except almonds. Pour into a 10-inch pie pan that has been sprayed with no-stick vegetable product. Sprinkle almonds over top. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until lightly browned. Serves 8.
